Class TokenRequest

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.sts.model.json.creators.TokenRequest
public class TokenRequest extends Object
An OAuth 2.0 token-exchange request body (RFC 8693) for POST /v1/token (operationId generateStsToken, spec schema TokenRequest).

Unlike the other request bodies in the SDK, this endpoint consumes application/x-www-form-urlencoded, so this type exposes its fields as a name/value map via toFormFields() (using the spec's property names grantType, scope, subjectToken, subjectTokenType) rather than being JSON-serialized.
